Powered by cloud-hosted quantum random number generators (QRNG), the EntropiQ client ensures a strong foundation for all cryptographic operations on the host. System Requirements ¶ Windows versions: Server 2019 or newer, Windows 10 or newer Permissions: LocalSystem Network requirements: Outbound TCP port 443 (HTTPS)

docs.text: Install ¶ Purpose ¶ Install the client on a Windows machine and complete basic configuration for typical use cases. Prerequisites ¶ Admin permissions required: Yes Dependencies: None Install Steps (GUI) ¶ Run the EntropiQ MSI (e.g., EntropiQ_RNG_Provider_[version].msi) Follow the prompts in the installation wizard Set the Connection Mode to API Enter the path to the Entropiq API server Enable "Set as Default Provider" Click Next Enter your API key Follow the prompts to complete the installation Silent Install ¶ Open the BAT file (e.g., INSTALL_[version].bat) Paste your API Key to set the value for the AGENT_API_KEY Save your changes and close the file Execute the batch script as an adminstrator Verify Installation ¶ Open the Windows Services Manager (services.msc) Find the service names starting with "EntropiQ" Verify they are running and set to Automatic
